scope: Static base artwork at rendered gallery scale; no claim of exhaustive native pixel inspection or completed animation
result: Accepted as static base artwork for this playable prototype
observations: All silhouettes and primary equipment are fully framed in the galleries; all 99 images load.
Consistent olive, graphite, ivory and amber palette with practical industrial materials.
Twenty distinct arena compositions provide readable central fighting surfaces.
LATCH, SWITCHBACK and ROOKGLASS share some hair/face traits, but prosthetic arm, clothing and cloak distinguish the silhouettes.
Some human enemy silhouettes remain close; CHOIR MARSHAL and PHASE CLERK share a blue-coat and dorsal-device visual family.
Large machines and aircraft are normalized for the duel renderer; gallery scale does not validate their fictional dimensions or edge collisions.
The tranquilizer dart tip is thin at gameplay scale and warrants future readability tuning.
Ballast native art points left; catalogue orientation and renderer baseFacing now preserve its leading direction without altering the PNG.
